mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior quarter's growth rate signals improving demand conditions, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth q/q > 0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior quarter's level signals weakening manufacturing activity, which depresses earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO q/q < 0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal income (RSAFS) below the prior quarter's level signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces demand and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS q/q < 0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% combined with a 2-month acceleration in average hourly earnings (HOUST) signals a tight labor market with rising wage costs, which reduces profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% for three consecutive months AND HOUST q/q > 0% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: tight labor market with rising wage costs
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior quarter's level combined with a 2-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening manufacturing and construction activity, which depresses earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO q/q < 0% for three consecutive months AND HOUST q/q < 0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
